listings.name: Playwright MCP
listings.description: Official Microsoft Playwright MCP — browser automation via accessibility snapshots (npx @playwright/mcp). Requires Node.js 18+.

listings.name: Chrome DevTools MCP
listings.description: Official Google Chrome DevTools MCP — control and inspect a live Chrome browser for automation, debugging, screenshots, and performance traces. Requires Node.js LTS and Chrome stable.

listings.name: Context7
listings.description: Upstash Context7 remote MCP — up-to-date, version-specific library docs and code examples (resolve-library-id, query-docs). Paste a Context7 API key at install for higher rate limits (context7.com/dashboard).

listings.name: Filesystem MCP
listings.description: Official Model Context Protocol filesystem server — read/write/search within allowed directories. Default allow-list is the workspace root (`.`). Edit args after install to add more absolute paths.

listings.name: Storybook MCP Addon
listings.description: Storybook official MCP addon (@storybook/addon-mcp). In your Storybook project run `npx storybook add @storybook/addon-mcp`, start the Storybook dev server, then enable this listing to connect at http://127.0.0.1:6006/mcp (adjust port if needed). Community: review before enabling.
